data.asar: Agar paas ho toh party lo, nahi toh taiyaari shuru!
data.caption:
Haryana Board 10th supplementary result is finally out! 

🎯 Regular students pass percentage is 66.16%
🎯 Open school students pass percentage is 47.74%

Supplementary ka stress khatam, ab aage ki planning shuru karo doston!

Kis kis ka result aaya, jaldi se tag karke batao! 👇
